About

Across engineering, astrophysics, and AI.

I am a machine-learning researcher with a PhD in astrophysics and a foundation in mechanical engineering. My work spans physical modelling, statistical inference, uncertainty quantification, time-series analysis, and astronomical imaging.

Experience

From lensing inference to time-domain astronomy.

2025—Present

Postdoctoral Researcher

University of Rome Tor Vergata

Developing machine-learning algorithms for transient detection and classification in Rubin LSST data using light curves and astronomical images. I use agentic coding tools such as Codex to support development, testing, debugging, and iteration of scientific analysis pipelines, while contributing to collaborative Rubin LSST and high-energy transient research.

2020—2025

PhD Researcher

IUCAA, Pune

Designed CNN and Bayesian neural network systems for strong-lens parameter inference from multi-channel Hyper Suprime-Cam imaging, estimated uncertainties and covariances, validated models on simulated and real observations, explored autoencoder denoising, and investigated gravitational-lensing probes of dark matter.
